channel.title: Saswata S. Sengupta — Blog
channel.description: AI agents in production, e-commerce CRO, and AI-era product management — with the numbers.

item.title: The cheapest e-commerce CRO: ship one fix a week
item.description: 17 boring fixes beat one big redesign. Weekly micro-forensics on checkout, forms and search — each measured — compound faster than a quarterly splash.

item.title: How a form fix lifted lead submissions by 124% in 28 days
item.description: A field-by-field form teardown with GA4 events and Clarity — one restrictive field caused 23% of drop-offs. The fix raised submissions +124% in 28 days.

item.title: Topshe: voice AI that runs entirely in your browser
item.description: Named after Feluda's assistant, Topshe runs Qwen 2.5 in-browser via WebAssembly — wake word, research and planning tools, zero data leaves.

item.title: I built my own LinkedIn outreach tool (766 commits later)
item.description: TGB Hunt: a self-hosted, open-source agent that finds recruiters, drafts intros, and never sends without my approval. 766 commits, GPLv3.

item.title: DhanPlan: a retirement calculator that speaks Indian finance
item.description: Building a calculator where SIP/EPF/PPF/NPS and FIRE are first-class citizens — product choices from projections to inflation. Design, scope, and tests.

item.title: The data deep-dive: 480K sessions to three real problems
item.description: The method behind the Sierra checkout teardown: instrument the funnel first, form ranked hypotheses second, never optimize an unmeasured funnel.

item.title: AI image greetings lifted feature engagement by 168%
item.description: A dormant 'Send Greetings' feature, an image-gen model, and a festival calendar across 27 occasions — feature engagement up 168% at LiveKeeping.

item.title: The 17:1 e-way bill gap: diagnosing B2B adoption
item.description: Why PRO+ users generated bills in Tally, not in-app — a two-week diagnostic that uncovered a 17:1 gap and changed the roadmap at C-suite level.

item.title: Daily report automation: 3 sources, 88 rows, 11 AM
item.description: A Google Apps Script pipeline unifying Kibana, MongoDB, and GA4 into one auto-populated report — what white-collar automation really costs.

item.title: 20+ discovery calls to a top-3 roadmap brief
item.description: At Upcore I ran 20+ prospect interviews across 12 verticals; the output was a prioritized opportunity brief with top-3 use cases.

item.title: 27 push notification triggers, 5 regions, one architecture
item.description: Designing a notification system across renewals, transactional states, and conflict logic — with priority tiers and a daily cap users don't hate.

item.title: FilmRisk.AI: scoring film risk with ML and Bayesian priors
item.description: A 2,200-film dataset, gradient-boosted ML plus Bayesian priors, and a scoring engine that backtests itself. I built FilmRisk.AI — the failures included.

item.title: Category page redesign that added +34% qualified leads
item.description: Story-led category journeys beat commodity grids: +17% PDP clicks, +34% qualified leads, −16% bounce in a 4-week sprint at Sierra.

item.title: Gold/silver/bronze lead routing that cut days to close
item.description: Sierra routed every lead the same way until the data said otherwise: web forms 63.5% CVR, cart abandonment 0.4%. A tiered router fixed the queue.

item.title: How we cut checkout abandonment from 73.1% to 53.9%
item.description: A 480K-session teardown: three separate checkout problems hidden behind one dashboard number, three targeted fixes, two sprints — −26% abandonment.
